items: 100% Cotton Terry Cloth & Superior Absorbency Made of premium thickened cotton terry material, this golf towel is soft, highly absorbent and fast-drying. It effectively wipes off dirt, grass stains, sand and debris from golf clubs, balls and hands, keeping your equipment clean and ready for every shot.

Tri-Fold Design for Easy Carry & Storage Measuring 16x25 inches when unfolded, this tri-fold golf towel is compact and lightweight. It fits easily in your pocket or golf bag without taking extra space, making it ideal for on-course, driving range and practice use.

Sturdy Metal Clip for Secure Attachment Equipped with a durable metal snap clip, the towel can be firmly attached to your golf bag for quick access. It prevents loss or slipping during play, solving the hassle of misplaced towels on the green.

Durable Stitching, Machine Washable & Color Fast Featuring fine edge binding and dense stitching, this golf towel is tear-resistant, lint-free and built to last. It will not fade or shrink after repeated machine washes, maintaining its color and shape for long-term durability.

Multi-Purpose for All Activities Not just for golf, this versatile towel also works great for the gym, beach, hiking, cycling, sports and daily household use. Combining practicality and quality, it is a must-have accessory for golfers and outdoor enthusiasts.
